21-Every logical run needs an
online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before execution. A prior successful run d
oes not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--project`, environment, and linked-project set
tings; a key can only access its own organization.\n22-\n23:With results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the cr
edential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project se
lection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names, and whethe
r a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executors). The server resolves the organization and account. The start-run reque
st sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs. MCPJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to the model,
as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds no debit,
quota draw, or balance refusal.\n24-\n25-`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable analytic

s, not the required run-start request. Results remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.
